    ((equal? esc (list 27 91))

    ((= b 16) "prev-line")
    ((= b 29) "jump-back")
    ((= b 22) "copy-region")
    ((string=? *vi-mode* "insert")
     (if (and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) b (pad:vi-ctrl b)))
    ((= b 104) "left")
    ((= b 106) "next-line")
    ((= b 107) "prev-line")
    ((= b 108) "right")

(define (pad:tx-blank? s i n)
  (if (>= i n)
      #t
      (let ((c (string-ref s i)))
        (if (or (= c 10) (= c 13) (= c 32))
            (pad:tx-blank? s (+ i 1) n)
            #f))))
(define (pad:tx-op-line line)
  (let ((n (string-length line)))
    (let ((eq (pad:tx-at line 0 n 61)))
      (if (< eq 1)
          #f
          (let ((name (substring line 0 eq))
                (lam (substring line (+ eq 1) n)))
            (if (string-prefix? lam "(lambda")
                (list name lam)
                #f))))))
